channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Chip Engelland | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Chip Engelland from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Alperen Sengun on Chip Engelland
item.description:
Alperen Sengun on Rockets assistant and shot guru Chip Engelland:

“I hear a lot of stories. A lot of good things about him.”

Alperen Sengun on Chip Engelland, Sep 22, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Josh Giddey on Chip Engelland
item.description:
Josh Giddey on Chip Engelland:

“We talk every day. We’re in here together every day. If he’s not here, we’re texting and calling. He’s been great. He’s told me he’s proud of me… I love that guy. We’ve spent a lot of time together these last 2 years.”

Josh Giddey on Chip Engelland, May 3, 2024. Source: Twitter @CAlmanza1007.

item.title: Josh Giddey on Chip Engelland
item.description:
Clemente Almanza:Josh Giddey on his progress as an outside shooter working with Chip Engelland and if he struggles avoiding old bad habits:

“I think that happens more when you're missing shots. Revert back to old habits. Maybe you don't trust the new stuff as much... I've been with him pretty much every day for the last 18 months and he's been great in that area.”

Josh Giddey on Chip Engelland, Apr 18, 2024. Source: Twitter @CAlmanza1007.

item.title: Keldon Johnson on Chip Engelland
item.description:
Keldon Johnson on the role Chip Engelland played in helping him gain his extension by molding him into 3-point threat:

“Chip helped me a lot. He’s a great coach, and I feel like I will forever be grateful for the time and the work that he put in with me on my jump shot.”

Keldon Johnson on Chip Engelland, Jul 27, 2022. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Dejounte Murray on Chip Engelland
item.description:
Tom Orsborn:Murray on his clutch 3:

“I love Chip Engelland to death. We do stuff like that. A lot of people might say, ‘Aah, it was luck, whatever.’ But we (practice) game winners.”

Dejounte Murray on Chip Engelland, Feb 9, 2021. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.
